---
title: "Colophon"
summary: "How this site is built: a bespoke Go static-site generator, no client-side JavaScript, and full source in the open."
---
This site is generated by a small static-site generator I wrote myself in Go, rather than a general-purpose framework. Markdown pieces are parsed, validated, and rendered to plain HTML at build time; nothing runs in your browser except the browser itself.

There is no JavaScript, no web fonts loaded from a third party, and no build step that reaches out to a network you cannot see. The pipeline checks its own output before it ships: broken internal links, missing alt text, and stray placeholder text all fail the build rather than reaching production.

Some drafts start with AI assistance, as noted on the home page; every published word is reviewed and edited by me. If you find a mistake, security@herinean.com reaches me directly.
